evidence.title: one canonical company spans different approved missions without merging their contexts
evidence.assertion: The portfolio lists one company with a 64-character hexadecimal opaque id and two contexts from two different approved missions; each context keeps its own objective and equals the source report entry for company, country, fit, rationale, uncertainty, gaps and verification; the result text contains no private negotiation text, buyer person name, email address or organisationId.

evidence.title: workspace ownership,member access and guessed cursors grant no other customer portfolio
evidence.assertion: A second member sees no companies and scopesRead 0, also when passing another portfolio resource as the cursor; an unknown account is refused with code 42501; a mismatched session subject is refused with status 409.

evidence.title: same approved bearer in another admitted account has a separate opaque identity namespace
evidence.assertion: When a second admitted account saves the same approved link it sees one company with one context, and that company id differs from the first account company id.
